description: Get visitor analytics for one of the connected account's products: views and unique visitors for the last 7 days, 30 days and all time, plus published/draft review counts. Set `breakdown` to also get WHERE the traffic came from: referring hosts, channels (search, social, referral, direct), campaigns, countries, devices, and a per-day visitor trend. Counters alone cannot tell a spike caused by one referrer from steady organic growth, so ask for the breakdown whenever the question is why traffic moved or which source is working. Read-only. Account-scoped: requires the MCP_API_KEY bearer token.

breakdown.description: Include traffic sources, channels, campaigns, countries, devices and the daily trend. Off by default because it runs a second, heavier aggregation.

period.description: Window for the breakdown. Ignored unless `breakdown` is true.

product.description: Product name or domain to look up (substring match). Optional when the account has one product.

name: get_product_analytics
